description: This file defines the AppDependencies and AppBootstrap classes in Dart, responsible for initializing and providing core application services and dependencies during startup.

classes.name: AppDependencies
classes.description: A data class that encapsulates core dependencies such as cache, repository, database, and download engine for the app.

classes.name: AppBootstrap
classes.description: A class responsible for bootstrapping and initializing application dependencies asynchronously.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes app dependencies including cache, database, repository, and download engine, returning an instance of AppDependencies.
